modules.name: TactileInput

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.description: Top synchronizes release for child modules

behavior: Two-stage synchronization before debounce; requires C_STABLE_CYCLES consecutive different samples to change stable state. A return to current level cancels candidate.
Press/release/raw-edge counters wrap at 65536. Held input is not repeated; a switch held through reset is counted once after the stable window.
constraints: 50 MHz clock, 3.3 V switch inputs; C_STABLE_CYCLES >= 1, C_REPORT_CYCLES >= 1, C_BAUD_CYCLES >= 2.
Production debounce 250000 cycles; report 1000000 cycles; UART divisor 434. Logical press counters survive any missed display refresh.
corner_cases: Reset clears all counters; held-at-reset input counts once.
Simultaneous keys do not share filter state. Counters and sequence wrap unsigned.
Raw telemetry is a sampled snapshot, not a lossless waveform.
verification_cases: xsim: bounce both edges, channel mapping, simultaneous press/release, long hold, modulo wrap, reset held.
Actual UART bits decoded independently in Python and Rust; CRC, fields, sequence, snapshot isolation.
Gowin routing/timing and SRAM download; physical per-switch test is separate evidence.

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.description: Top synchronizes release for child modules

behavior: Every C_REPORT_CYCLES, if idle, atomically snapshot sequence, raw/filtered masks, presses, releases, and raw edges. Busy ticks are skipped, not queued.
Emit exactly 87 bytes, B1 + 80 hex payload characters + * + CRC8 + CR LF. CRC polynomial 0x07, zero seed, covers the 82 ASCII body bytes.
Each byte uses start/accept/wait sequencing with the unchanged EncoderUartTx. Snapshot source changes cannot alter an in-progress frame.

modules.name: TactileButtons

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.description: Top synchronizes release for child modules

behavior: Hold internal reset until two-stage external release and power counter bit 15 (32768 cycles). Initialize startup counters to zero.
Instantiate six independent TactileInput channels, SW1 on bit zero and highest 16-bit counter slice. Reporter continuously captures coherent data.
SW2 is AB18 according to actual interface schematic, not the spreadsheet AA18 typo. All button ports are input-only; other peripherals are not scanned. RGB stays low and PA disable high.
